serverInfo.description: Doxa MCP: Know the God who speaks. A Christian AI for any question, in any season. Truth that points to Jesus, and to real relationships. For anyone, the believer growing, the seeker searching, the curious, the hurt. Built for the growing seasons (loving God more, discerning calling, real testimonies of His goodness) and the hard ones (doubt, grief, religious trauma, deconstruction, apologetics, the questions that bypass easy answers). Bible (Berean Standard, public domain), real testimonies, encouragement, apologetics. Points to Jesus, never to itself, and to real human community over more AI. 5/5 on the independent faith.tools Christian-AI rubric. Three tools: doxa_encourage, doxa_scripture, doxa_way_movement. Categories: Christian, Bible, Scripture, apologetics, faith, prayer, encouragement, theology, discipleship, grief, doubt, calling, hope.
